It is a READ tool because it retrieves search results. The advertised inputs send a search `query` to a fixed search/vendor service rather than making a request to an agent-chosen URL or host, so it is not treated as a SINK. No advertised access to local files, intranet, localhost, user credentials, or private SaaS data, so no SECRET label.

tavily_extract.rationale: The description says `Extract content from URLs` and `Returns raw page content`; content at arbitrary web URLs can be attacker-authored, so the output is UNTRUSTED. The `urls` argument makes the tool contact agent-supplied URLs, so a request to an attacker-controlled URL can deliver agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable host, making it a SINK. The text does not advertise any scheme, localhost, intranet, or private-network restriction, and also mentions `protected sites`; under the least-restrictive reading, supplied URLs could reach non-public `file://`, `localhost`, intranet, or protected content, so SECRET is retained and the point is undetermined. It is otherwise a READ tool because it extracts and returns content.

tavily_crawl.rationale: The description says `Crawl a website starting from a URL` and `Extracts content from pages`; pages and links on an arbitrary website can be attacker-authored, so the output is UNTRUSTED. The `url` argument makes the tool contact an agent-supplied URL, so a request to an attacker-controlled host can deliver agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination, making it a SINK. The advertised text does not restrict URL schemes or exclude `localhost`, intranet, or other non-public reachable sites; under the least-restrictive reading the crawl could return non-public content or internal URLs, so SECRET is retained and undetermined. It is a READ tool because it crawls and returns extracted content rather than modifying state.

tavily_map.rationale: The description says `Map a website's structure` and `Returns a list of URLs found starting from the base URL`; URLs found on an arbitrary website can be attacker-authored, so the output is UNTRUSTED. The `url` argument makes the tool contact an agent-supplied URL, so a request to an attacker-controlled host can deliver agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination, making it a SINK. tavily_research.rationale: The description says it will `gather information from multiple sources` and `Returns a detailed response based on the research findings`; public or third-party sources can contain attacker-controlled content that influences the returned response, so the output is UNTRUSTED.
